title: Assessment of Acoustic Metawindow unit through psychoacoustic analysis and human perception

findings.mechanism: AMW unit reduces sound pressure levels, leading to a decrease in perceived loudness.
findings.quote: Loudness (N) is effectively reduced, specifically for a perpendicular distance of 0.5 m, with RMS(Eff) between 3.12 and 3.89 times the JND.

findings.consequent: Loudness (N) (psychoacoustic parameter) at measurement point c
findings.mechanism: Measurement point c is in the direction of the lateral opening of the AMW unit, not benefiting from acoustic diffraction.
findings.quote: Point c is not significantly affected as it is placed in the direction of the lateral opening of the AMW unit, so it does not benefit from any acoustic diffraction effect.

findings.mechanism: AMW unit reduces medium-high frequency pitch components, which are characteristic of perceivable roughness.
findings.quote: A significant decrease in R is also perceived in terms of JND through the application of the AMW unit. ... RMS(Eff) between 1.41 and 2.18 times the JND.

findings.mechanism: AMW unit's medium-high frequency filtering capacity with middle-high frequency peaks reduction leads to a decrease in sharpness.
findings.quote: the S reduction in JND is particularly high (RMS(Eff) reaches 12.12 and 15.58 in these measurement points).

findings.mechanism: Fluctuation Strength is inversely related to Sharpness, and the AMM-based system minimally impacts it.
findings.quote: The contribution is indeed mostly negligible in this psychoacoustic parameter.

findings.mechanism: The AMW unit neutralizes sound sources, leading to a less chaotic perceived soundscape.
findings.quote: the first resulted as 7% less chaotic than the second one

findings.mechanism: The AMW unit neutralizes sound sources, leading to a less eventful perceived soundscape.
The AMW unit neutralizes sound sources, leading to a less vibrant perceived soundscape.
The AMW unit neutralizes sound sources, leading to a more monotonous perceived soundscape.
The AMW unit neutralizes sound sources, leading to a more uneventful perceived soundscape.

findings.antecedent: AMW unit effect on #2 Woodland recording
findings.mechanism: The AMW unit's effect negatively impacts the pleasantness of the #2 Woodland recording.
findings.quote: #2 Woodland is negatively affected in terms of pleasantness, 17% less than the original one.

findings.antecedent: AMW unit effect on #4 Pedestrian zone and #5 Park recordings
findings.mechanism: The AMW unit's effect negatively impacts the pleasantness of #4 Pedestrian zone and #5 Park recordings.
findings.quote: #4 Pedestrian zone_w and #5 Park_w are negatively affected in terms of pleasantness, 19% less than the original one.

findings.antecedent: AMW unit effect on #5 Park recording
findings.mechanism: The AMW unit's effect makes the #5 Park recording perceived as more monotonous.

findings.antecedent: AMW unit effect on #5 Park recording
findings.mechanism: The AMW unit's effect makes the #5 Park recording perceived as more uneventful.

findings.antecedent: AMW unit effect on #6 Shopping Mall recording
findings.mechanism: The AMW unit neutralizes high-pitched 'talking' sound sources, which the human brain finds stressful when messages cannot be elaborated.
findings.quote: this configuration is perceived as slightly more annoying

findings.antecedent: AMW unit effect on #6 Shopping Mall recording
findings.mechanism: The AMW unit neutralizes high-pitched 'talking' sound sources, which the human brain finds stressful when messages cannot be elaborated, leading to less pleasantness.

findings.consequent: high-pitched sound sources (e.g., human voices, birds, car horns, kids playing)
findings.mechanism: The AMW unit's filtering capacity neutralizes sound sources with high pitches.
findings.quote: The application of the AMW unit tends to neutralise sound sources with high pitches, including the "talking" ones

findings.mechanism: Both analytical and perceptual methods show a reduction in loudness due to the AMW unit.
findings.quote: Both analyses show preliminary agreement in their Loudness reduction results through the AMW unit application.

findings.antecedent: AMW unit effect on #2 Woodlands, #3 Quiet Street, #4 Pedestrian Zone, and #6 Shopping Mall recordings
findings.mechanism: The AMW unit has a less perceivable impact on loudness for these specific recordings.
findings.quote: a less perceivable change in Loudness is highlighted from Psychoacoustic and Perceived analysis for recordings #2 Woodlands, #3 Quiet Street, #4 Pedestrian Zone, and #6 Shopping Mall.

stimuli.description: seven environmental sound recordings (Beach, Woodlands, Quiet Street, Pedestrian Zone, Park, Shopping Mall, Busy Street) presented with and without the AMW unit effect (14 total recordings)

tables.description: RMS of Effectiveness of the AMW unit (EffX) according to four psychoacoustic parameters: Loudness (N), Roughness (R), Sharpness (S), and Fluctuation Strength (FS) across three measuring points (a, b, c). Values are JND multiples.

limitations: The AMW model used for these experiments was the basic one (without broadband optimisation) due to the current pandemic situation.
Further study is needed to clarify if Roughness and Sharpness decrease has a positive or negative impact, depending on outdoor sound sources.
Further work is needed to understand if the AMW unit's impact implies an improvement of the indoor soundscape and how it can serve specific functions according to different outdoor noise sources.
